item.title: AbbVie vs UCB Psoriatic Arthritis
item.description:
• Summary: In a head-to-head trial, AbbVie’s IL-23 inhibitor Skyrizi (risankizumab) failed to demonstrate superiority over UCB’s IL-17A/F inhibitor Bimzelx (bimekizumab) in psoriatic arthritis. The Biospace report details that Bimzelx achieved better composite response rates, challenging Skyrizi’s position in the immunology market. This result could shift prescribing patterns, especially given Bimzelx’s dual IL-17 blockade. The data highlight the competitive landscape for TNF‑α alternatives in PsA and the growing importance of head-to-head comparisons in rheumatology.
  • MoAs: Risankizumab: anti-IL-23 p19 monoclonal antibody; Bimekizumab: anti-IL-17A/F monoclonal antibody
  • Sources: Biospace
